Frequently asked questions about Simone Galipò
 Sample of 20 matches, from 21/09/2025 to 27/10/2026. Answers refer to the matches in the table and the selected filters.
 Card totals and percentages use yellow plus red cards in this sample.
 What is Simone Galipò’s average number of cards per match?
 Simone Galipò averages 5.70 yellow cards and 0.20 red cards per match across the 20 matches analysed: 5.90 cards per match in total.
 What are Simone Galipò’s penalty statistics?
 Simone Galipò has awarded 9 penalties in the 20 matches analysed, averaging 0.45 per match.
 How often does Simone Galipò exceed 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 cards?
 Across the 20 matches in the sample, the total exceeded 3.5 cards in 90.0% of matches, 4.5 in 70.0% and 5.5 in 55.0%.
 How much does Simone Galipò’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 20 matches analysed, 5.0% ended with 0–2 cards, 40.0% with 3–5 and 55.0% with 6 or more.
 How do Simone Galipò’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 6.20 cards, compared with 5.90 across all 20 matches analysed.
 How does Simone Galipò distribute yellow cards between home and away teams?
 Across the 20 matches analysed, home teams average 2.50 yellow cards and away teams 3.20. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
